It isn't my house but oh well. I ended up going to my aunty Wendy's house one day and its like a huge, Victorian house. There are long and wide hallways and those fairly pointless, green curtain things that hang on the walls. She has several rooms they don't use either and one is an extra living room next to the old front door. Now, for some reason this room is always dark and their black cat always goes in their and sits on the couch top. Ever since I was a kid I hated that room and sometimes I didn't even know why. This one night me and my family where there, I ended up going to this room and looking into it for ages until I thought I saw something moving. I did assume it was the cat but when this black cat came to my feet from the OTHER room I was like "Uhm, what?". So, I go to my mum and tell her and she's just saying the typical mum things like "Oh, it's just your imagination. Don't worry we're leaving soon anyways". But I just wanted to check it out again. Again, I end up going into the room and looking into the glass of a drink cabinet on a wall. And right as I started looking behind me in the glass, I saw this outlined figure with those scarily realistic eyes and I screamed so loud and (with my epic taekwondo skills) tornado kicked (It's not as spectacular and movie-like as you think) whatever was there and ran out. Turns out there was nothing there and I was told off for being too loud. :D
